messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "increase weekly until symptoms are controlled or your heart rate slows noticeably"
set: ["increase weekly until symptoms are controlled or your heart rate slows noticeably", "continue until blood pressure or symptoms are controlled", "monitor heart rate", "increase by 500 mg increments weekly", "panic attacks are new or worsening symptoms", "avoid driving or hazardous activities until effects are known", "mood or behavior changes are new or worsening symptoms", "check blood pressure and heart rate regularly", "avoid driving or other dangerous activities until effects are known", "do not drive or use machinery until effects are known", "wait until your next scheduled dose", "may be increased to 20 mg per day after one week if symptoms are not adequately controlled", "call healthcare provider if symptoms are severe", "adjust weekly or less often", "weekly (injection)", "once weekly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
